LanguageData.LP_Path_Monk.label: monk
LanguageData.LP_Path_Monk.description: The DND monk masters the body with ki: Martial Arts, Deflect Missiles, Step of the Wind, Diamond Body, Flurry of Blows, Stunning Strike, Open Hand Technique, Quivering Palm, and ultimately Empty Body. Strongest unarmed (or with a quarterstaff); fists and kicks use vanilla melee resolution, and Isekai's Strength and weapon mastery apply as usual; ki effects are multiplied by psychic sensitivity. Each tier requires the matching Melee level (6/9/12/15/18).
LanguageData.LP_Path_Monk.tooltip: Monk: Melee sets ki power; strongest unarmed.
LanguageData.LP_Path_Paladin.label: paladin
LanguageData.LP_Path_Paladin.description: The DND paladin wields the oath as a sword: Divine Smite, Vow of Enmity, Sacred Weapon, Swap Guard (Melee), Lay on Hands, Aura of Protection, Aura of Courage, Banish Evil (Social), and ultimately Holy Avatar. Either Melee or Social 6 unlocks the path; each ability uses its own skill (6/9/12/15/18). The weapon hit resolves as usual; the extra holy damage and healing are multiplied by psychic sensitivity. Liches cannot learn it.
LanguageData.LP_Path_Paladin.lockedReason: Requires Melee or Social 6, or adventurer Charisma 13 (liches cannot learn it)
LanguageData.LP_Path_Paladin.tooltip: Paladin: the Melee branch governs smites, the Social branch governs auras and Lay on Hands.
